Extract language from html lang attribute

```kotlin title="Kotlin (Android)"
import io.xberg.android.*
import com.fasterxml.jackson.module.kotlin.jacksonObjectMapper

fun main() {
    val mapper = jacksonObjectMapper().setPropertyNamingStrategy(com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.PropertyNamingStrategies.SNAKE_CASE)
    val options = mapper.readValue("{\"extract_metadata\":true}", ConversionOptions::class.java)
    val result = HtmlToMarkdown.convert("<html lang=\"es\"><head><title>Spanish Page</title></head><body><h1>Hola Mundo</h1><p>Este es un documento en español.</p></body></html>", options)
    println(result.content)
}
```
